newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Cyprus to issue convertibles, issue stocks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus to issue convertibles, issue stocks.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus Group will issue up to 50 million Cypriot pound subordinated convertible bonds to be listed on the Luxemburg stock exchange, the first Cypriot bank to do so, it said in a statement.

The subordinated bond issue which has been given the green light from the board of directors of the Bank of Cyprus and the Bank of Cyprus (investments) is subject to the approval of the extraordinary meeting of the group's shareholders on October 2.

The big chunk of the issue for sums between 35 and 40 million pounds will go to foreign investors and the rest to Cypriot investors with preference given to current Bank of Cyprus shareholders, it said.
The bonds will be converted to ordinary shares and the price will be higher than the current market price of each share, it said.
The Bank of Cyprus Group also intends to go ahead with a rights issue for 25 million pounds on or after May 1, it said.
Salomon Brothers International is the proposed lead manager of the convertible bond and rights issue and Cypriot Cisco to be the advisor of the bank, it said.
The effect of these two issues is to increase the foreign investors' stake to between 7.0 and 9.0 percent of the bank's equity, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
